اضطبنت (form VIII)
# اِضْطَبَنْتُ (iḍṭabantu) /idˤ.tˤa.ban.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اِضْطَبَنْتَ (iḍṭabanta) /idˤ.tˤa.ban.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اِضْطَبَنْتِ (iḍṭabanti) /idˤ.tˤa.ban.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اِضْطَبَنَتْ (iḍṭabanat) /idˤ.tˤa.ba.nat/: thi
